text: Τὸ σῶμα τὸ σόν, νηστείας κατατήξασα, ἀγρύπνοις εὐχαῖς, τὸν Κτίστην καθικέτευσας, τοῦ λαβεῖν συγχώρησιν, τὴν τελείαν τῆς ἁμαρτίας σου· ἣν καὶ ἔλαβες ἀληθῶς, ὁδὸν μετανοίας ὑποδείξασα.
english: Having wasted thy body away with fasting, thou didst entreat the Creator with sleepless prayers, that thou mightest receive the perfect forgiveness of thy sin; which indeed thou didst truly receive, having shown forth the way of repentance.

text: Преобразил еси земнаго княжения славу / во иночества образ смиренный, / и вместо врагов видимых / на невидимыя ополчился еси, / и, обою победитель красен являяся, / един от чудотворец Печерских показался еси; / темже и нам ревности Божия дар испроси, / братолюбием сердца наша просвети / и ко спасению вечному стези наша, Феодоре блаженне, направи.
english: Thou didst transform the glory of an earthly princedom into the humble habit of the monastic life, and instead of visible foes thou didst take up arms against the invisible; and appearing a comely victor over both, thou wast shown forth as one of the wonderworkers of the Caves. Wherefore, ask thou for us also the gift of zeal for God, enlighten our hearts with love for the brethren, and direct our paths unto eternal salvation, O blessed Theodore.

text: Красоты ризныя возгнушавшагося/ и богатства тленнаго со благодарением отвершагося,/ в ризу же безстрастия облекшагося/ и богатому в щедротах Христу возследовавшагося,/ приидите, вернии, восхвалим Феодора достославна,/ яко молящася непрестанно/ о душах наших.
english: Him who abhorred the splendour of costly vesture and with thanksgiving renounced corruptible riches, who clothed himself in the robe of dispassion and followed after Christ who is rich in mercies: come, O ye faithful, let us praise Theodore, worthy of all glory, for he prayeth without ceasing for our souls.

text: От юности, преподобне Феодосие, / желание твое ко Христу Богу вперил еси, / егоже ради град и отечество оставль / и славу суетную, яко прах вменив, / последовал еси преподобному Димитрию / и обители его сожитель был еси, / преселився ко граду Тотьме / и в междоречие вселився, / постом и бдением, и власяным одеянием, / и веригами тело твое удручил еси. / Сего ради Бог, видев твоя труды, / по преставлении твоем чудесы обогати тя: / бесы изгоняеши и слепыя просвещаеши, / от всяких недуг и бед избавляеши приходящия к тебе с верою и вопиющия: / слава Давшему ти крепость, / слава Венчавшему тя, / слава Дающему тобою всем исцеление.
english: From thy youth, O venerable Theodosius, thou didst set thy desire upon Christ God, for whose sake thou didst forsake city and fatherland and, accounting vain glory as dust, didst follow the venerable Demetrius and become a dweller in his monastery; and removing to the town of Totma and settling in the land between the rivers, thou didst wear down thy body with fasting and with vigil, with a garment of hair and with chains. Wherefore God, beholding thy labours, enriched thee after thy repose with wonders: thou drivest out demons and givest light to the blind, and thou deliverest from every sickness and affliction those who come to thee with faith and cry: Glory to him who gave thee strength; glory to him who crowned thee; glory to him who works healings for all through thee.

text: От мирскаго мятежа изшед,/ преподобне отче наш Феодосие,/ и в тихое пристанище достиг,/ преподобному Димитрию сожитель был еси,/ и оттуду, Божиим Духом направляемь,/ во град Тотьму преселился еси,/ и во отоцех водных обитель себе воздвигл еси,/ идеже равноангельное житие пожив,/ последовал еси Христу,/ Егоже ради власяну ризу и вериги на теле твоем носил еси./ Смирением и нищелюбием украсився,/ славу суетную презрел еси/ и отеческое имение добре расточил еси,/ молением же к Богу и слезными струями бесы посрамил еси,/ темже по успении твоем Христос даром чудес обогати тя./ Имея убо дерзновение ко Господу,/ преподобне отче наш Феодосие,/ моли Христа Бога, да спасет души наша.
english: Having gone forth from the turmoil of the world, O our venerable father Theodosius, and having attained unto a quiet haven, thou wast a fellow dweller with the venerable Demetrius; and thence, guided by the Spirit of God, thou didst remove to the town of Totma and didst raise up for thyself a monastery upon the islands amid the waters, where, living a life like unto the angels, thou didst follow after Christ, for whose sake thou didst wear a hair shirt and chains upon thy body. Adorned with humility and with love for the poor, thou didst despise vain glory and didst well scatter abroad thy father's substance; and by prayer unto God and by streams of tears thou didst put the demons to shame. Wherefore, after thy falling asleep, Christ enriched thee with the gift of wonders. Having therefore boldness before the Lord, O our venerable father Theodosius, pray to Christ God, that our souls may be saved.

text: Воздержанием плоть изнурил еси/ и непрестанными молитвами, яко Ангел, возвысился еси,/ струями же слезными бесовския полки погрузил еси./ И ныне во Свете невечернем ликуеши у Христа Бога/ и приходящим ко святому твоему гробу неоскудно исцеление подаеши,/ верою вопиющим тебе:/ радуйся, отче Феодосие Богомудре.
english: Thou didst waste thy flesh away by abstinence, and by unceasing prayers thou wast raised on high as an angel, and with streams of tears thou didst drown the hosts of the demons. And now thou rejoicest in the Light that knoweth no evening before Christ God, and upon those who come to thy holy tomb thou bestowest healing without stint, as they cry to thee with faith: Rejoice, O father Theodosius, thou of godly wisdom.

text: Προκληθείς ουρανόθεν προς γνώσιν ένθεον, την εν σαρκί του Δεσπότου επιδημίαν εν γη, αυτοψεί εωρακώς φωτός πεπλήρωσαι, όθεν του Παύλου κοινωνός, θεηγόρος γεγονώς, την Κρήτην πάσαν πυρσεύεις, της ευσεβείας τω λόγο, Τίτε απόστολε μακάριε.
english: Called from heaven unto knowledge divine, and having beheld with thine own eyes the sojourning of the Master upon earth in the flesh, thou wast filled with light; whence, becoming the companion of Paul and a herald of God, thou dost set all Crete ablaze with the word of piety, O blessed apostle Titus.

text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.
english: O holy Apostles, pray ye to the merciful God, that he may grant unto our souls forgiveness of our transgressions.

text: Cu dumnezeieștile învățături strălucind, Părinte Sfinte, ai păstorit Biserica neamului tău și ai tâlcuit Evanghelia lui Hristos. Pentru aceasta, te-ai arătat, Sfinte Ierarhe Varlaam, ca un mare apărător al dreptei credințe.
english: Shining with the divine teachings, O holy father, thou didst shepherd the Church of thy people and didst expound the Gospel of Christ. Wherefore thou wast shown forth, O holy hierarch Varlaam, as a great defender of the true faith.

text: Vrednic slujitor al lui Hristos și înțelept apărător al dreptei credințe, mare cinstitor al Sfintei Cuvioase Parascheva și credincios luminător al neamului românesc, Sfinte Ierarhe Varlaam, roagă pe Hristos-Dumnezeu să ocrotească și să mântuiască sufletele noastre.
english: O worthy servant of Christ and wise defender of the true faith, great venerator of the venerable Saint Paraskeva and faithful enlightener of the Romanian people, O holy hierarch Varlaam, pray to Christ God to protect and to save our souls.
